script: Jupiter spins faster than any other planet. A day there lasts less than 10 hours. It spins so fast that it bulges out at its equator. Its stripes are bands of clouds stretched out by that fast spin. Jupiter also has auroras bigger than all of Earth. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
